It was held biennially in odd-numbered years from 1969 to 2015 and annually starting from 2016. More recently, IJCAI was held jointly every four years with ECAI since 2018 and PRICAI since 2020 to promote collaboration of AI researchers and practitioners.

Three research awards are given at each IJCAI conference. The IJCAI Computers and Thought Award is given to outstanding young scientists under the age of 35 in AI. The Donald E. Walker Distinguished Service Award is given to honor senior scientists for their contributions and service to the field of AI. The IJCAI Award for Research Excellence is given to scientists who have carried out a research program of consistently high quality throughout an entire career yielding several substantial results.

The International Joint Conferences on Artificial Intelligence Organization (IJCAI Organization) is a nonprofit organization founded in 1969 to promote science and education in the field of AI. It is the main organizer of the IJCAI conference series and is also responsible for handling related activities.

The 33rd International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026) is being jointly held with the European Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Bremen, Germany, from August 15 to August 21, 2026.

The 33rd International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026) is being jointly held with the European Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Bremen, Germany, from August 15 to August 21, 2026. As one of the most established and comprehensive gatherings in the field, IJCAI has served as the premier international forum for AI research since its inception in 1969.

The conference’s dual heritage—IJCAI’s global reach combined with ECAI’s deep European roots—means attendees will encounter a diverse range of methodologies, application domains, and theoretical advances. Whether your focus is on foundational algorithms or applied systems, the technical program is designed to surface the most rigorous and impactful research of the year.

The conference is also valuable for journalists and analysts covering AI trends, as well as representatives from funding agencies and non-profits involved in AI governance. Registration for IJCAI-ECAI 2026 will open closer to the event date. Pricing details—including early-bird rates, student discounts, and fees for workshops and tutorials—are to be announced. For the most current information and to register once available, visit the official conference website at ijcai-ecai-26.org.
